evidence_reference.old_byte_representation: exact git blob via git show; JSON node hashes equal the accepted old worktree despite line-ending differences
evidence_reference.method: Exact unique ability name; isomorphic whole-node raw leaf values; unique sibling subtree anchors only, never array order or repeated scalar order; known field/type namespaces separated.
evidence_reference.opaque_policy: Old and new opaque identifiers are retained without semantic promotion. Electric is a source-review holdout, not a supported query element.

whole_ability_evidence.scope: Full source shape and leaf-value identity; only the separately witnessed known fields/types gain names. Opaque fields/types remain opaque.
